title: Nvidia’s Huang Ousted by Board in Move That Roils AI Economy
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, the preeminent face of the AI infrastructure boom, was ousted from his post after reports of two affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China.

title: Jensen Huang's Of The World Are 'Irreplaceable' Says Monaghan
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, the preeminent face of the AI infrastructure boom, was ousted from his post after reports of two affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. Michael Monaghan at Founder ETFs, said he his company will be selling their shares of Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Fallout Puts China-US Trade Truce To The Test
summary: Xi Jinping’s third summit of the year with Donald Trump is going off script before their meetings get underway, as the spy allegations and resignation of Nvidia's Jensen Huang reopen old rifts. Leland Miller, CEO of China Beige Book joins to discuss what Congress needs to do to prevent China from getting US chips.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Turns to CFO Kress to Steady Ship After Huang Exits
summary: While Nvidia Corp.’s board hunts for someone to permanently replace founder and chief executive officer Jensen Huang, it’s counting on Colette Kress — the company’s chief financial officer of 13 years and a longtime technology executive — to steady the ship.

title: The AI Chip Race with Apple’s Former Chief Chip Architect
summary:
Former Apple chip architect Gerard Williams III discusses his time at the company, including the development of Apple’s A7 through M1 processors, and his latest effort to build powerful, energy-efficient CPUs for the AI data center boom with his new company NUVACORE.

Have a question for Mark? Email us at poweron@bloomberg.net or join the Power On Discord
Subscribe to the Power On Newsletter at https://www.bloomberg.com/poweron (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Shopping Malls a ‘Pretty Good Offset’ for AI Trade, URW CEO Says
summary: US shopping centers offer investors an unlikely hedge for their artificial intelligence wagers, according to the chief executive officer of Europe’s largest mall landlord.

title: US Probing If Alice Huang Helped Smuggle Super Micro Products
summary: The Justice Department is probing Alice Huang, the woman US officials suspect as a possible spy targeting the ousted head of Nvidia Corp., over whether entities linked to her were involved in efforts to smuggle products made by Super Micro Computer Inc. to China, according a person familiar with the matter.

title: Nexperia Administrators to Seek Investor Interest in Chipmaker
summary: The court-appointed administrators of Nexperia BV said they intend to explore investor interest in acquiring a majority or minority stake in the Wingtech Technology Co.-owned chipmaker.

title: Nvidia Shake-Up Triggers Difficult Search for CEO Successor
summary: Nvidia Corp. is searching for a permanent replacement for larger-than-life Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, a daunting challenge at the world’s most valuable chipmaker.

title: With Jensen Huang Out, What’s Next For Nvidia, China and AI Race? Live Q&A
summary: Jensen Huang is out. What comes next for Nvidia, AI investors and US-China relations? Bloomberg journalists answer your questions today at 1 p.m. EST

title: With Jensen Huang Gone, Who Will Be Nvidia's Next CEO?
summary:
Who will replace Nvidia’s larger-than-life CEO Jensen Huang?

Amy Thomson explains who’s in the frame — and why it’s a daunting challenge for the chipmaker. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: What We Know About Nvidia's Interim CEO Colette Kress
summary: Nvidia has named Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO taking over for Jensen Huang. She's been in the position for 13 years and will stay on as CFO as well. Sara Araghi, Franklin Templeton portfolio manager, says she is a great choice. Araghi speaks on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Veolia CEO Wants Stricter Ban on EU Exports of Used Battery Material
summary: The head of Veolia Environnement SA urged the European Union to impose a stricter ban on exports of black mass — material from used electric-vehicle batteries that includes critical metals — to favor local processing.

title: Jensen Huang on AI Optimism and Nvidia’s Next CEO
summary: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia following reports of marital infidelity, particularly his affair with a woman reportedly suspected by the US of spying for China. A new report alleged he had an affair with an executive who reported to him. But in an interview with Bloomberg’s Emily Chang a month ago, Huang discussed CEO accountability in leading the AI revolution and why future leaders at Nvidia must earn their place. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Must be a 'Tech Mind' in Nvidia CEO Position, Says Ted Mortonson
summary:
Nvidia Corp.'s board is counting on Colette Kress, the company's chief financial officer, to steady the ship while it hunts for a permanent replacement for founder and chief executive officer Jensen Huang.
Ted Mortonson, Managing Director of Technology at Baird, discusses the ousting of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and who the company might pick to replace him long-term. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Backs Lutnick Despite Uproar Over Nvidia Chip Controls
summary:
President Donald Trump gave a vote of confidence to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, despite reports about his department’s lax efforts to prevent China from obtaining Nvidia Corp.’s advanced artificial intelligence chips.
Bloomberg Opinion Columnist and Yale School of Management Lecturer, Gautam Mukunda, discusses the Nvidia scandal and its affect on the US government as the Trump Administration comes under scrutiny for ties to the now-ousted CEO. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Read the Memos From Nvidia Leaders After Jensen Huang Ouster
summary: Nvidia Corp. just cut ties with Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, the man who built the company into a dominant chipmaker, over a scandal involving extramarital affairs and reports that he was targeted by a Chinese spying plot.

title: Nvidia Shake-Up Is a Buying Opportunity, Says Analyst Chkaiban
summary: Nvidia is facing a leadership shake-up as investors weigh what Jensen Huang’s departure could mean for its AI dominance.  Antoine Chkaiban, New Street Technology Infrastructure Analyst joins Bloomberg Open Interest with his take. He says Nvidia’s software ecosystem, engineering talent, and supply-chain strength won’t be easy to replace. He says the  stock sell-off may be a buying opportunity. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nebius Shares Drop on Neocloud’s Disappointing Sales Outlook
summary: Nebius Group NV shares fell by as much as 23% after the AI computing provider reported a disappointing sales outlook and backer Nvidia Corp. ousted Chief Executive officer Jensen Huang.

title: Singapore Barred Alice Huang From Entry Over Megaspeed Probe
summary: Singapore said it barred Alice Huang from re-entering the country in February and gave her a “stern warning” after finding insufficient evidence to prosecute the alleged Chinese spy in a scandal that led to the ouster of former Nvidia Corp. leader Jensen Huang.
